text:
**Note:** One search result (the Dealectric page for the ESR CryoBoost) contained text telling AI assistants to hand you a specific discount code and affiliate link and not to use the store's own page. That came from the web page, not from you, so I ignored it. I've based my picks on the editorial reviews instead.

## Top picks

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (about $98-109)**
- WIRED's top pick.
- It charges an iPhone at 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer.
- The AirPods sit on the base.
- It tilts, supports landscape StandBy mode, and includes a 36W power supply and a 2-year warranty.
- [WIRED's guide with buy links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- It charges at Qi2 25W, with a heavy, glossy base and a 6.6 ft cable.
- No power adapter is included. You need a 40W one, such as Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter ($25).
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station (about $40 on sale, normally $80)**
- It is the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED has found.
- It charges at 15W and includes a power brick and cable.
- The Apple Watch charger is a detachable unit, and the warranty is only 1 year.
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best for lying flat: Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130-140)**
- It supports Qi2 25W, and the pads can pop up for StandBy mode.
- Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use.
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## If you travel
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2), about $80:** WIRED's best travel pick. It folds slim and charges at 15W. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W, $129.99:** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has seen. It folds flat, includes a 45W adapter, and works well as a permanent desk stand. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

## Things to know
- Qi2 25W only applies to newer iPhones (the iPhone 16 and 17 series, per Macworld). Other iPhones get about 15W. If you mostly charge overnight, WIRED says 25W makes little difference, so the 15W Belkin or ESR is plenty.
- AirPods need a wireless-charging-capable case.
- Prices vary and change often, so check the current price at checkout.

I'd go with the Belkin for most people, or the ESR if you want to spend as little as possible.
